about:
Serán Bioscience, LLC is a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) headquartered in Bend, Oregon. Founded in 2016 by Dan Smithey, Ph.D., who serves as president and CEO, the company began as an integrated provider of drug product development, formulation, and manufacturing solutions for pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients.

The company offers a full continuum of services from preformulation and formulation development through dosage form development and cGMP manufacturing. Its capabilities span oral solid dosage forms — including capsules, tablets, powder-in-bottle, multiparticulates, and mini-tablets — as well as enabling technologies such as spray drying, hot melt extrusion, fluid bed coating, film coating, and particle size reduction via jet and nano milling. Serán operates modern development facilities and is constructing a 100,000-square-foot commercial manufacturing campus to support late-stage clinical and commercial-scale production. The team has grown to over 200 scientists, engineers, and operations staff.

Serán serves pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies advancing molecules from discovery through commercialization. Its clients rely on the firm for material-sparing prototype screening, technology selection for enabled formulations (spray drying, lipid-based systems, particle engineering), and scalable clinical manufacturing of solid oral and inhalable particulates.

The company differentiates itself through its proprietary "Right From the Start™" development paradigm, which integrates drug product intermediate and drug product development in parallel to accelerate timelines. Leadership emphasizes flexibility in unit operations, adaptable manufacturing suites, and on-site ICH stability storage as key to meeting client milestones.
